title: Grand Canyon Trip Planner Printable, South Rim Itinerary 1 2 3 Days, Best Rim Walks & Hikes, National Park Travel Guide PDF, Packing List
description:
Planning a first trip to the Grand Canyon? This 30-page printable guide puts the whole South Rim trip on paper, so you arrive knowing where to stay, which shuttle to take, which walks fit your group and how far to go below the rim.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- The park at a glance: South Rim vs North Rim, Hermit Road, Desert View Drive and the free shuttle routes
- When to go, season by season, with rim and canyon temperatures in °F and °C
- Booking timeline for lodges, campgrounds and the Phantom Ranch lottery, plus the October 2026 entrance fees and passes
- Airports, gateway towns (Tusayan, Williams, Flagstaff) and the two entrances
- Sample plans for 1, 2 and 3 days on the South Rim
- 6 rim walks for every fitness level and 4 short canyon hikes on the South Kaibab and Bright Angel, with distance in mi and km, climb in ft and m, from nps.gov, and where to turn around
- 'Down is optional, up is mandatory': why the climb back out takes longer
- Heat, water and salty snacks, winter ice, altitude, storms and safety at the edge
- A 'no signal' page, packing checklist, day-plan pages, a trip budget sheet and a trip log
- Official sources, questions to ask a ranger, and visiting with kids

WHAT YOU GET
- US Letter and A4 versions
- Color and printer-friendly (low ink) versions
- Instant download. This is a digital file; nothing is shipped.
- Bonus: our free one-page Ultimate Hiking Checklist

GOOD TO KNOW
Checked against nps.gov in October 2026. Rim to river and back in one day is not a plan for beginners. Conditions and rules change, so check nps.gov/grca before your trip. For personal use.

Made by HikeSupply Co., a small shop for weekend hikers. More printable guides at hikesupplyco.com
